source_evidence: Make sure you read and understand this agreement, as well as the adviser’s relationship summary and Form ADV Part 2 Brochure.
answer: When evaluating an investment adviser, ask for the firm’s latest Form ADV, including its brochure and brochure supplement. The source also says to read and understand the Form ADV Part 2 Brochure along with the adviser’s relationship summary and your agreement. It does not explain what information the brochure supplement contains, so ask the adviser about its contents if you need clarification.
